summary_brief: 今日是延续 9/26 以来"Agent 基础设施成熟化"主线的推进日，无方向性转折。最核心的升级点是 Agent 从一次性对话向"长时运行、可恢复服务"范式切换——多项目不约而同投入状态（任务、checkpoint、工作树、记忆）持久化与跨会话恢复（ruflo ADR-406、langgraph 状态修复、deer-flow 跨网关 Blob 恢复），这是对 10/02 增量/原子化持久化的实质推演。安全与治理延续 10/01 的沙箱化与凭据防泄漏主线（封堵代码反射沙箱逃逸、强制工具白名单、固定 MCP 目标防 SSRF 凭据泄漏），可观测性与成本归因（Langfuse 追踪、指标基数控制、成本准确统计）继续深化。最具标志性的新推进点是 ruflo 迈出"进程内集成"的历史一步：迁移至 Claude Code Mod API（路由延迟由 18.2ms 降至 0.045ms）并发布含 14 种视图的 /ruflo 监控控制台，把 10/02 上线的 Mods 插件架构从"被生态适配"推向"真正的生产级落地"。整体定位：属于 9/30/10/01/10/02 的同构延续，新增点是把长时运行可靠性与工具进程内集成双双推向生产级成熟。

engineering_signals.title: 长时运行 Agent 的状态持久化与跨会话恢复成为核心基础设施议题
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个独立项目不约而同地投入于 Agent 运行状态（任务、checkpoint、工作树、记忆）的持久化与断线恢复能力，表明 Agent 从一次性对话向长时运行、可恢复的服务范式转变是当前最明确的行业方向。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 沙箱与执行环境安全加固成为密集投入方向（沙箱逃逸封堵、凭据防泄漏、工具白名单强制）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个顶级项目同日发布针对 Agent 安全的关键修复：封堵代码反射沙箱逃逸向量、强制工具白名单、固定 MCP 服务目标防 SSRF 凭据泄漏、阻断危险命令真正执行。这反映行业正系统性地补齐 Agent 工具调用与代码执行的安全契约。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 可观测性与成本归因体系成熟化（Langfuse 追踪、指标基数控制、成本准确统计）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: BYOK 第三方提供商的追踪接入、Prometheus 指标基数爆炸修复、流式用量成本高估纠正等，标志着 Agent 工具链从'能用'走向'可观测、可治理、可归因'，为大规模部署与计费审计提供基础。

engineering_signals.title: ruflo 生态里程碑：迁移至 Claude Code Mod API 并发布一体化监控控制台
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 从 shell 钩子转向 Claude Code 的进程内 mod API（路由延迟从 18.2ms 降至 0.045ms），并推出含 14 种视图的 /ruflo 可视化控制台，代表 AI 代理工具从外部脚本集成向深度进程内集成的方向性演进。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 长上下文管理精细化演进（上下文压缩、保活尾部、提示词缓存、按需加载）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多项目在上下文压缩协议标准化（ACP compaction_update）、尾部 keep_recent 保留、Qwen 提示词缓存默认开启、技能工具懒加载等方向密集投入，共同指向超长上下文 Agent 会话稳定性这一普遍痛点。

engineering_signals.title: LLM 调用可靠性与限流处理全面加强（退避重试、Retry-After 语义、连接错误覆盖）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目同日为 LLM connection、429/5xx、Retry-After 头、MCP 服务器瞬时错误等建立更完善的退避重试机制，反映在大规模/生产环境中 LLM 调用与工具接入的瞬时故障鲁棒性已成为刚需。

engineering_signals.title: 多提供商适配与自有抽象层收敛（原生协议接入、统一提供方路由、按需依赖）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: openai/codex 增加自定义模型提供商能力开关、opencode 为 Cohere 建原生提供方并统一路由、promptfoo 将 WatsonX 改为按需引入、microsoft/agent-framework 隔离 OpenAI/Azure 元数据，多个项目正同时向'多提供方可插拔 + 自有抽象层'架构收敛。

engineering_signals.title: MCP 生态能力扩展与协议交互增强（浏览器多会话隔离、TUI 托管工作树、自动重试、错误类型化）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Playwright browser_tabs 的 isolatedContext、Codex 通过 MCP 暴露 Git 工作树管理、MCP 连接自动重试与 MCPClientError 类型化导出，显示 MCP 正从简单工具协议演进为支撑复杂 Agent 工作流与跨会话状态的关键协议层。

engineering_signals.title: 前端/客户端性能与渲染体验优化（Suspense 回退修复、流式表格、构建缓存）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Next.js 同日修复多个浅 URL 更新触发 Suspense 回退导致失焦卡顿的问题，opencode 通过请求整形将 unsupportedParts 开销降 22 倍，反映对 Agent 前端交互流畅度与流式渲染性能的细致打磨。

engineering_signals.title: 代理式编码基础设施深化：Git 工作树编排与可写文件流式传输
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Codex 同日落地通过 MCP 向 TUI 暴露异步 Git 工作树创建/挂载，以及 exec-server 的可写文件流式传输与按偏移量写入能力，为 AI 代理构建结构化的并行编码工作区与高效大文件写入奠定底层基础。

engineering_signals.title: OpenClaw 多代理网关平台级优化（内存释放、冷启动缩短、按需加载、工作线程调度）
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenClaw 同日发布多项网关性能优化：释放已完成任务堆内存、将存储校验延后缩短冷启动、worker 按需加载降低内存占用、工作区操作移出网关线程——标志着多代理网关正走向生产级高并发与长生命周期部署。

release_signals.title: Claude Code 全面增强与安全修复
release_signals.why_it_matters: 作为核心产品，本次更新引入了大量新功能（如 /ruflo 控制台、MCP OAuth 重新认证、代码审查配置等），并修复了多个关键安全漏洞（如危险 rm 命令绕过），对开发者的日常使用体验和安全保障有重大影响。

release_signals.title: ruflo 转型为 Claude Code Mod
release_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 从基于 shell 命令的经典钩子迁移到 Claude Code 的 mod API，实现了进程内路由和状态管理，性能提升显著（路由延迟从 18.2ms 降至 0.045ms），代表了 AI 代理工具集成方式的重大演进。

release_signals.title: ruflo 发布 /ruflo 控制台
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增的 /ruflo 控制台将 Claude Code 转变为 ruflo 的实时监控和操作界面，提供拓扑图、任务看板、成本仪表盘等 14 种视图，并支持无头模式，极大提升了代理集群的可观测性和管理效率。

release_signals.title: ruflo 发布关键安全补丁
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复了 PreToolUse 钩子中命令拒绝不生效的严重安全漏洞，以及 MCP 工具可能向未授权服务发送凭据的问题，对于依赖 ruflo 进行安全敏感操作的用户至关重要。

release_signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK 重大更新
release_signals.why_it_matters: v0.23.0 引入了多项新特性，包括可配置的 MCP 列表页限制、可选的 Docker 移除保护、可配置的内存整合轮次以及加密历史扫描预算，并包含大量核心稳定性、安全性和沙箱相关的修复，是 SDK 的一次重要版本升级。

release_signals.title: 微软 Agent Framework 1.20 发布
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增了 DuckDB、SQL Server 和 TypeSafe AI 连接器，并重构了 Foundry Hosting 以支持请求级代理工厂和持久化沙箱会话，增强了框架的集成能力和企业级部署选项。

release_signals.title: Cline 桌面版引入连接器中心
release_signals.why_it_matters: 桌面版 v0.0.42 和 v0.0.43 将 Connectors 作为默认标签页，并新增了完整的连接器目录浏览、搜索和推荐功能，简化了第三方工具和服务的集成流程。

release_signals.title: OpenClaw 发布扩展稳定版
release_signals.why_it_matters: 作为 LTS 版本，v2026.8.35 不仅包含关键安全更新和可靠性修复，还新增了对 GPT-6.1 Sol 模型的支持，并强化了更新恢复、代理完成和渠道集成等核心功能。

release_signals.title: Agno 知识库同步增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: v3.1.1 为知识库页面同步引入了实时进度报告和取消机制，并修复了大型站点的同步完整性问题，提升了知识管理的可靠性和用户体验。

release_signals.title: Cline 代理团队性能优化
release_signals.why_it_matters: 通过优化状态持久化策略，解决了代理团队在长时间运行和流式传输时的性能退化问题，并自动压缩现有数据，显著提升了大规模代理协作的稳定性。

releases.summary:
## What's changed

- Added `$.ui.selection()` for mods: returns the text you last selected in fullscreen mode and, when the selection lies within one transcript row, that row
- Added a built-in `gh api` to cloud sessions whose image has no GitHub CLI, and fixed the built-in sending control characters from file names, jq filters or GitHub errors to the terminal
- Added recovery for a prompt cleared with Ctrl+C: pressing Up on the empty prompt brings the draft back, including pasted text and images
- Added a re-authenticate prompt when an MCP server asks for more OAuth scope during a tool call
- Added `--max-findings <n>|all` to /code-review to report more or fewer findings than the usual limit; the choice is reused until you pass `--max-findings default`
- Added Ctrl+F to find a session by name and Alt+↑/↓ to jump between groups in the agents view; both, and rename, can be rebound in keybindings.json
- Added a screen reader mode announcement of the new permission mode when you approve a plan, including with Shift+Tab
- Fixed mid-response API timeouts failing the turn: non-interactive sessions and subagents now continue from the partial response, and thinking-only responses are retried
- Fixed long conversations failing with "Prompt is too long" instead of auto-compacting when the last reply reported zero token usage
- Fixed `--resume` sometimes dropping files and other context that a compaction had just restored
- Fixed a resumed session sometimes not saving the last response of a turn, so that the next `--resume` showed the prompt unanswered
- Fixed resume occasionally loading a transcript cut short when the same session rewrote the file during the load
- Fixed resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier dropping the model's earlier thinking
- Fixed session titles, memory recall and prompt hooks failing on Mantle or behind gateways that reject structured outputs; added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_OUTPUTS` to turn structured outputs off
- Fixed auto mode denials pointing Claude at a Bash permission rule when the blocked tool was not Bash
- Fixed auto mode on Bedrock and Mantle switching to the local classifier for the rest of the session after a request to an older model, such as a WebFetch summary or a `sonnet` subagent
- Fixed cloud sessions that restarted on a newly picked model replying with that model after the server refused it
- Fixed Cowork cloud sessions staying marked as waiting for input after a WebFetch permission prompt for an unapproved URL went unanswered for five minutes
- Fixed prompt suggestions not appearing on a phone that joins a Cowork cloud session started on another device
- Fixed a mod's button sometimes running a different button's action when pressed on a view drawn before Claude Code restarted
- Fixed a plugin's pane showing nothing when one `Code` element held a diff that does not parse; it now draws as plain code
- Fixed plugin LSP servers receiving literal `${user_config.*}` and `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` placeholders in `initializationOptions` and `settings` instead of substituted values or manifest defaults
- Fixed a plugin's `tool.call` hook making Bash fail and file searches read the wrong folder in subagents that run in a worktree
- Fixed `git-subdir` plugin installs failing, or caching an incomplete plugin, on older git (before 2.39, e.g. Ubuntu 22.04's 2.34)
- Fixed plugins loaded with `--plugin-dir` not showing "Configure options" in `/plugin`
- Fixed background sessions ending when a plugin was reloaded or disabled while one of its timers or reads was still running
- Fixed sandboxed heredocs with an unquoted delimiter (`python3 <<EOF`) asking for approval on every run under sandbox auto-allow when the body holds only plain text and simple `$VAR` references
- Fixed Bash tool permission check to prompt before a `BASHPID` assignment whose value the shell would evaluate as arithmetic, instead of allowing it silently
- Fixed fullscreen sessions exiting with "unrecoverable interface error" when opening the background tasks dialog while a plugin or mod showed rows above the prompt
- Fixed Claude reporting a message to another session as delivered when that session held it: the notice now says it wasn't delivered and names the session, and in SDK sessions Claude can now learn of it mid-turn
- Fixed OpenTelemetry `claude_code.tool.blocked_on_user` spans reporting `unknown` source or decision in `-p` and SDK sessions and for PreToolUse hook approvals
- Fixed permission asks that ended unanswered, in `-p` or on an interrupted turn, emitting no `tool_decision` event
- Fixed Edit and Retry in Cowork cloud sessions refusing a message sent before `/compact` even though its history was still saved
- Fixed unattended sessions (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) retrying for hours after a very long response stream failed; Claude Code now streams again, and gives up after three timeouts
- Fixed `/login` reporting "Login successful" when credentials could not be saved to secure storage; it now shows the failure, and offers a retry when the new login didn't take effect (anthropics/claude-code#73861)
- Fixed a Stop during Bedrock credential lookup sometimes moving the session to a fallback model instead of ending the request
- Fixed a second `gcpAuthRefresh`/`awsAuthRefresh` browser sign-in opening when a laptop wakes from sleep while another Claude Code process is signing in
- Fixed agent teams: a plugin-defined agent spawned by name now runs with its own prompt, tools, disallowedTools and effort instead of the defaults
- Fixed headless (`-p` / SDK) sessions occasionally ignoring SIGTERM when a supervisor such as `timeout` or systemd sends SIGCONT alongside it
- Fixed restarted cloud sessions restoring a model that the organization's enforced model list refuses
- Fixed MCP tool calls sometimes running twice when a remote server's result was over 16 MB or could not be parsed
- Fixed subagents in Claude Desktop's Code tab getting none of the tools of a user-configured MCP server named `memory`
- Fixed Claude in Chrome asking before every screenshot and page read on a site you allowed when auto mode is unavailable (such as with `disableAutoMode` or an older model); typing, navigation and JavaScript still ask
- Fixed `claude plugin install` failing for GitHub-source plugins on macOS and Linux machines with no GitHub SSH key: the clone now falls back to HTTPS and prints a notice
- Fixed `sandbox.credentials.files` entries on git config files not taking effect while `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` is on
- Fixed Claude leaving out your organization's design systems when starting slides or a design with the Artifact tool on Team and Enterprise plans or machines with managed settings
- Fixed the keyboard not working on Windows after Claude Code restarts itself (first sign-in to a Claude apps gateway, provider setup, `/tui`)
- Fixed a stall when launching an agent whose `tools:` lists very many `Agent(...)` entries
- Fixed sessions on Claude 3 Opus and Claude 3 Sonnet failing on every turn after a whole PDF entered the conversation
- Fixed the npm auto-updater reporting success when the platform-native binary failed to download and only the placeholder `claude` stub was installed
- Fixed Remote Control cleanup archiving a session that is still connected or was just re-attached by another Claude Code process
- Fixed `owner/repo` plugin marketplaces showing only the second attempt's error when both the SSH and HTTPS fetch fail; both errors are now shown, with the transport tried first on top
- Fixed path-scoped `.claude/rules` and nested CLAUDE.md files not loading when Write or Edit creates or changes a file in their scope (previously only Read loaded them)
- Fixed a dangerous `rm` (such as one on `/` or the home directory) inside a `bash -c` or `sh -c` script running without a prompt in bypassPermissions mode or under a shell allow rule (anthropics/claude-code#96300)
- Fixed LSP tool calls hanging indefinitely when a language server uses dynamic capability registration or stops responding; requests now time out after 60s (per-server `requestTimeout`)
- Fixed `idle_prompt` notification hooks firing while background agents are still running (anthropics/claude-code#93672)
- Fixed PreToolUse and PermissionRequest hooks being skipped when matching them failed or the tool's input could not be serialized to JSON; the call is now blocked
- Fixed the first request in a fresh environment or after a model switch using the built-in output limit and auto-compact window, not the server's; that request may now wait up to 1.5 seconds
- Fixed the "What should Claude do instead?" hint showing on the Interrupted row after sending queued messages with ctrl+enter
- Fixed `/login` in a `--bare` session running a sign-in the session never reads, which could replace your saved login; it now says which credentials work
- Fixed the InstructionsLoaded hook omitting agent_id and agent_type when a subagent's file access loads a rule or nested CLAUDE.md; rules and nested CLAUDE.md files loaded on file access now also report effort
- Fixed the Agent tool in `claude mcp serve` always reporting no available agents and rejecting every subagent_type
- Fixed the terminal cursor not following the typed text in the fullscreen transcript viewer's search and in `/theme`'s custom color search
- Fixed `/permissions` in screen reader mode: typing a rule's number now picks it instead of opening the search box
- Improved auto mode: when a conversation grows too long for the client-side safety classifier to review, it is now compacted instead of prompting for, or failing, every tool call
- Improved screen reader mode: short announcements, such as a deleted word, now stay on screen until your next key press or until something above them on screen changes
- Improved screen reader mode: answered questions in question dialogs now say "answered" beside their box
- Improved the `/usage-credits` message shown to Team and Enterprise members whose organization has turned off usage credit requests
- Improved cloud sessions: a new conversation's first turn no longer waits for a stdio MCP server whose config sets `alwaysLoad: false`
- Improved "You should know" notes to say "we", "the main agent" or "you" depending on who was responsible for a decision
- Improved the error for an artifact database write refused at the database's size limit: it now states the limit and what frees space
- Improved Bash permission prompts to give a shorter reason when part of a command can't be checked before it runs
- Self-hosted runner: Improved the built-in `gh api`: a refused gh command now prints its `gh api` equivalent, `--paginate` follows every page of a repository's lists, and a nested `claude` no longer removes it
- Improved Remote Control's recovery from an expired server credential: sessions stay connected during renewal and are kept if it gives up after a server outage
- Changed the background command time limit to apply only in unattended sessions (`-p`, Agent SDK, CI, cloud); terminal, desktop app and VS Code sessions have no limit
- Changed the client-side auto mode classifier to ignore an `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` pin that names Claude Sonnet 5.5 or Opus 5.5 and use Claude Sonnet 5 instead
- Changed `claude project purge` to `claude purge`; the old name still works and prints a notice
- Changed the agents view `n:` filter (and Ctrl+F search) so Enter opens the session whose name matches best instead of the top row
- Changed `/autocompact` to save the auto-compact window per model, so each model keeps its own setting when you switch
- Changed MCP URL prompts from servers that can't report when you're done to wait for "I'm done, continue" before the tool call continues, so you can finish in the browser first
- [VSCode] Fixed a claude.ai connector staying on "Needs authentication" after you authorize it: the MCP servers dialog now offers Check connection
- [VSCode] Fixed the opt-in New Conversation shortcut (Cmd/Ctrl+N) starting a conversation in every visible Claude view instead of only the one you are in
- [VSCode] Fixed the chat view resuming the next saved session after you archive the one it shows; it now starts a new conversation instead
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed the Cloud sessions switch in Claude Code admin settings staying locked off while an unrelated security setting was loading or had failed to load
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed pressing Stop while a self-hosted runner was still starting not cancelling the queued message, which could then run once the runner was up
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude Tag admin settings offering a "Remove this scope" option, which always failed, on channels whose settings were created automatically
- [Claude Tag] Improved Claude to also follow a related Slack thread in another channel that it only read, so updates there reach the conversation that depends on them
- [Claude Tag] Improved save errors on a channel's Configure page: too-long channel instructions now say to shorten them, and a save refused for lost access no longer says to try again
- Fixed `claude plugin test` reporting mods as turned off remotely when it had only read an out-of-date saved setting

key_changes: 新增对 mod 的 UI 选择支持、内置 gh api、Ctrl+C 清除内容的恢复，以及按名称查找会话和导航分组等功能
修复了大量会话恢复、自动压缩、MCP 工具调用、插件加载、沙盒权限、Bash 工具安全性等问题，包括一个危险的 rm 命令绕过漏洞
改进了自动模式分类器、屏幕阅读器模式、Cloud 会话和自托管运行器的行为，并重命名了 claude project purge 命令为 claude purge
修复了 VSCode 扩展中连接器认证、新会话快捷键和聊天视图恢复的问题
修复了多个安全相关问题，包括 bypassPermissions 模式下 rm / 命令绕过提示的严重安全漏洞
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本次 v2.1.288 版本包含大量修复和改进，覆盖了多个方面：新增了 mod UI 选择、内置 gh API、Ctrl+C 草稿恢复等新功能；修复了大量会话恢复、自动压缩、MCP 调用、插件加载、权限检查等问题；特别修复了一个关键安全漏洞——在 bypassPermissions 模式或 shell 允许规则下运行 bash -c 或 sh -c 脚本中的危险 rm（如删除 / 或主目录）命令不再绕过提示。此外还改进了自动模式分类器、屏幕阅读器、Cloud 会话和自托管运行器等行为，并重命名了 `claude project purge` 为 `claude purge`。

- Refreshed the model catalog. Default models change for DigitalOcean (GPT-6.1 Sol), GMI Cloud (Qwen 3.8 Flash), NanoGPT (Pareto 26.10 Preview), Nvidia (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), and Ofox (GPT-6.1 Sol)

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.summary:
- Agent teams no longer slow down as a session runs or while a teammate is streaming. Every streamed chunk and 2-second heartbeat used to re-save the whole team state, including every finished teammate's full transcript (one local `teams.db` reached 1.66 GB, with a single run row rewritten ~339k times). Stream chunks and heartbeats now go to live UIs only and are never persisted, only changed entities are written (batched into one transaction every ~300 ms), run records keep a summary instead of the transcript, and `team_events` is capped per team (2000 rows, 30 days). SQLite team storage moves to schema v2 with a one-time migration that compacts existing data; `SqliteTeamStore.vacuum()` returns the freed space when called explicitly. Failed team writes are retried instead of dropped
- Standalone provider requests made outside a session (such as commit message generation) can now resolve Cline surface headers. `sessionId` is optional in `resolveProviderRequestHeaders`, and `X-Task-ID` is omitted rather than sent empty
- Refreshed the model catalog. Default models change for DigitalOcean (GPT-6.1 Sol), GMI Cloud (Qwen 3.8 Flash), NanoGPT (Pareto 26.10 Preview), Nvidia (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash), and Ofox (GPT-6.1 Sol)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.89...sdk/sdk/v0.0.90

key_changes: 大幅优化 Agent 团队状态的持久化性能：流式数据不再持久化，仅写入变更实体并批量事务处理（约每 300ms），消除了会话运行时的性能降级问题
SQLite 团队存储迁移至 schema v2，自动压缩历史数据，支持 SqliteTeamStore.vacuum() 显式回收空间，团队写入失败改为重试而非丢弃
team_events 表增加上限控制（每团队 2000 行、保留 30 天），防止数据库无限膨胀
独立 Provider 请求支持解析 Cline 消息头，sessionId 变为可选参数，不再发送空的 X-Task-ID 头
刷新模型目录，多个云服务商（DigitalOcean、GMI Cloud、NanoGPT、Nvidia、Ofox）的默认模型发生变更
ai_summary.summary_cn: 本版本核心优化了 Agent 团队的持久化性能，将流式数据改为仅实时展示不落盘，并通过批量事务和数据库压缩手段解决了数据库膨胀（最大达 1.66GB）和写入次数过多的问题。同时增强了独立 Provider 请求的消息头解析能力，并刷新了多个云服务商的默认模型。团队存储迁移至 schema v2，属于非破坏性的单次自动迁移，整体影响中等。

releases.author: kausmeows
releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features

- Live progress & cancellation for page sync: `Knowledge.stream_sync_pages()` / `astream_sync_pages()` yield typed `PageSyncProgress` snapshots plus one terminal `SyncReport`, and `sync_pages` / `async_sync_pages` accept an `on_progress` observer. A workflow function step can now yield `StepProgress(content=..., data=...)` before its `StepOutput`, emitted as a native `StepProgressEvent` under the existing workflow run/step ID — AgentOS streams it over the existing workflow REST/SSE route, and `AgentOSClient.run_workflow_stream()` parses it. Cancelling a sync now actually reaches the work instead of draining to the end. (#10098)
- Page sync reports name failed pages: `SyncReport.failed_paths` lists the site paths of pages that failed to publish/delete (capped at the first 20, like `errors`; `failed` keeps the full count; defaults to `()` so existing callers/stored reports are unaffected). Logs now name the page and its cause chain, e.g. `Page sync failed for /guides/setup.md (SyncFailed: sync_failed <- ConnectError: [Errno 104] Connection reset by peer)`, plus a new `Page delete failed for …` warning on the prune path. (#10729)

## Bug Fixes

- Retry transient page-fetch failures with backoff: on large corpora (e.g. [docs.agno.com](http://docs.agno.com/), 3,913 pages) 1–2 random pages failed per run with `Connection reset by peer`. Each attempt previously consumed the entire 30s fetch deadline (leaving no time to retry) and retries were too short — both are fixed with a bounded per-attempt timeout and backoff. (#10730)
- Complete page sync for Mintlify-style sites: large Mintlify sites (e.g. [docs.langchain.com](http://docs.langchain.com/)) synced as `partial` even when every page indexed — and a `partial` result skips pruning, so removed pages stayed searchable indefinitely. Discovery now skips links to non-page files (`.json`, `.yaml`, `.xml`, `.csv`, `.pdf`, images/audio/video, archives, fonts — while keeping `.js`/`.css` as valid page names like `/guides/node.js`), and handles nested indexes, MDX code blocks and redirect aliases. Off-host page links still block pruning (by design). (#10726)

## What's Changed
* feat: name failed pages and their causes in page sync reports by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10729
* fix: retry transient page fetch failures with backoff by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10730
* feat: add AgentOS lifecycle support for Knowledge page synchronization by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10098
* fix: complete page sync for Mintlify-style sites (non-page links, nested indexes, MDX code, redirect aliases) by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10726
* chore: Release v3.1.1 by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10736


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/compare/v3.1.0...v3.1.1

key_changes: Knowledge 页面同步新增实时进度与取消支持：stream_sync_pages()/astream_sync_pages() 产生 PageSyncProgress 快照及终止 SyncReport，并支持 on_progress 观察者回调，取消操作可真正中断同步任务
AgentOS 工作流步骤支持 StepProgress 事件，可通过现有 REST/SSE 路由流式传输进度信息
页面同步报告现在列出失败页面的路径及失败原因链（前 20 个），并新增页删除失败告警日志
修复大批量页面抓取时的瞬时连接失败问题：采用有界超时与退避重试机制
修复 Mintlify 风格大型站点的页面同步不完整问题：跳过非页面文件链接，支持嵌套索引、MDX 代码块和重定向别名
ai_summary.summary_cn: agno v3.1.1 主要围绕 Knowledge 页面同步功能进行增强与修复。新增了页面同步的实时进度报告、取消支持以及在 AgentOS 工作流中流式传输进度事件的能力，同时同步报告现在会详细标注失败页面及其原因。此外还修复了两个关键问题：批量页面抓取时的瞬时连接失败（通过退避重试解决）以及 Mintlify 风格大型站点页面同步不完整导致旧页面无法移除的问题。

releases.author: ruvnet
releases.summary:
Security patch for `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` (`latest`, `alpha`, `v3alpha` → 3.51.1). Upgrading is recommended.

**PreToolUse `pre-bash` denials now block (#3623).** When the hook handler recognised a denied command, it exited with status 1. Claude Code treats that as a non-blocking hook error, so the command could still run. Denials now exit 2, the status Claude Code's PreToolUse uses to block. The fix covers both shipped `hook-handler.cjs` copies and the handler `ruflo init` generates. Existing projects pick it up with `npx ruflo@latest init upgrade` (or a helper refresh).

**MCP tools send credentials only to configured services (#3624).** `x_federation_*` and `seraphina_guidance` read env-only credentials (`RUFLO_X_ADMIN_TOKEN`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_KEY`). Their destinations are now pinned to the server-configured HTTPS base (`RUFLO_X_GATEWAY_URL`, `SERAPHINA_METALLM_URL`). A URL tool argument is only an assertion that must match that base; an absent, null or empty argument means no assertion. Every credential-bearing request rejects redirects. Operator configuration may name a loopback HTTP service for local or self-hosted gateways.

Verified: signed helper manifest at 3.51.1, witness manifests 117/117 on linux, macOS and Windows. A fresh `npx ruflo@3.51.1 init` writes the exit-2 handler.

releases.summary:
## ruflo 3.50.0: ruflo as a Claude Code mod

Install with `npx ruflo@latest`; `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow` and `ruflo` are all at 3.50.0.

Claude Code mods let a plugin hook the engine directly, as in-process TypeScript functions instead of shell commands. This release brings ruflo onto that API. It is **opt-in**: the classic hooks stay the default and the automatic fallback, and ruflo behaves exactly as before when function hooks are off.

### What's new
- **`ruflo mods install | uninstall | status | doctor | sync-policy`** and **`ruflo init --mods`** (ADR-404, #3608). Install writes only project-scoped files (`.claude/settings.local.json`, `.claude-flow/mods/install.json`).
- **The `ruflo-mods` plugin:**
  - **Routing:** in-process prompt routing, byte-identical to the classic `route` hook. In-process it takes 0.045 ms median versus 18.2 ms for a spawned hook.
  - **`tool.check`:** fed by ruflo policy, and it only ever tightens a verdict.
  - **Also:** edit learning signals, the cost budget ladder, and a status bar.
  - **`$.ruflo` noun:** `segment`, `lastRoute` and `snapshot`, so other mods (ruOS among them) can add to ruflo's status bar instead of drawing their own.
  - **Mod trust gate:** for mods loaded mid-session, including ones Claude writes. It only observes by default; `refuse-risky` is opt-in, and the allow-list matches the install source, not a self-declared name.
- **The `ruflo-swarm` pane mod 0.3.0** (#3607): a live pane with one tile per agent, which light up as agents read and write. It also shows the topology, the task and claims board, cost and tokens, the router's pick and hive-mind votes, and has buttons that act through the ruflo CLI. Claude Code subagents appear as tiles.
- **`ruflo-ruos`** (ADR-405, #3605): run swarm agents on your own ruOS cloud desktops.
  - **Transport:** only the tenant-authenticated fleet MCP and the ruOS jobs API (ADR-105). The unauthenticated desktop executor port is never used.
  - **Live run:** a live run on a real desktop passed, and the desktop was stopped and verified afterwards.
- **`ruflo-plugin-creator` 0.3.0:** a `create-mod` skill and template for scaffolding governed mods.

### Requirements and caveats
- Requires Claude Code **2.1.287 or newer**, where mods are on by default. Versions 2.1.277–2.1.286 need `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1`.
- Anthropic's rollout switch must also be on for your account. `ruflo mods doctor` reports its state, and it flipped during development.
- The mods API is early access and may change.

### Verified
- **Registry:** latest, alpha and v3alpha are 3.50.0 for all three packages.
- **Fresh install:** `npm i ruflo@3.50.0` gives `ruflo v3.50.0`; `mods install`, `status` and `doctor` work and write only inside the project.
- **Plugin tests:** engine-kit tests pass on 2.1.287 (ruflo-mods 16/16, ruflo-swarm 38/38, ruflo-ruos 3/3), and `claude plugin validate` passes for all three.
- **Release integrity:** the witness passes 117/117 on linux, macos and windows, and the signed helper manifest verifies.

Coordinated with the ruOS lane: `@cognitum/ruos` 0.3.0 ships the ruOS mod and the jobs API clients.

Gist: https://gist.github.com/ruvnet/aede145f8e730eb434e14decbb3f10a1

key_changes: 新增 ruflo 作为 Claude Code mod 的支持（opt-in，经典 hooks 仍为默认），包含 `ruflo mods install/uninstall/status/doctor/sync-policy` 等新命令
发布全新 `ruflo-mods` 插件：进程内提示路由（时延从 18.2ms 降至 0.045ms）、`tool.check` 策略收紧、编辑学习信号、成本预算梯度及状态栏等能力
新增 `ruflo-swarm` pane mod 0.3.0：实时多 agent 面板，展示拓扑、任务/声明板、成本与 token、路由选择及 hive-mind 投票
新增 `ruflo-ruos`：在自有 ruOS 云桌面上运行 swarm agents，仅使用租户认证的 fleet MCP 和 jobs API（ADR-405）
发布 `ruflo-plugin-creator` 0.3.0，提供 `create-mod` 技能与模板用于脚手架受治理的 mods
ai_summary.summary_cn: ruflo v3.50.0 将 ruflo 接入 Claude Code 的 mods API（进程内 TypeScript 函数而非 shell 命令），作为可选的增量能力引入，经典 hooks 仍保持默认且为自动回退路径。该版本带来了 ruflo-mods 路由/策略/成本控制插件、ruflo-swarm 实时多 agent 面板、ruflo-ruos 云桌面 swarm 运行支持以及 ruflo-plugin-creator 脚手架工具。需要 Claude Code 2.1.287 或更高版本，部分版本需手动开启环境变量，且 mods API 目前属于早期访问阶段。

This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of August 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.9.7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.9.7)

## 2026.8.35

### Highlights

- **GPT-6.1 Sol support:** add the current Sol model across OpenAI routing, discovery, reasoning, harness, and Reef guard-model boundaries. (#161400, #162955)
- **Safer updates and recovery:** preserve plugin settings, prevent duplicate Gateways, handle pnpm package updates without terminal failures, and retain plugin inventory through migration. (#160344, #160193, #161920, #161485) Thanks @EndeavorPioneer, @grtninja, @alkor2000, @xilopaint, and @aniruddhaadak80.
- **Reliable agent completion:** preserve complete delegated and CLI answers, release suspended child capacity, recover full cron output, and prevent failed requests from consuming steered questions. (#162843, #162368, #160520, #162439) Thanks @zyz619963502zyz, @holgergruenhagen, @armstrongsam25, @davidcittadini, @jayzhou2309, and @obviyus.
- **Security and ownership hardening:** keep secret-store kinds stable during rotation, restore admitted secret-egress execution, and retain explicit cron tool allowlists while repairing stale automatic snapshots. (#160926, #160760, #162432) Thanks @zachisfine, @yetval, @VACInc, and @obviyus.
- **Channel and integration reliability:** repair Gmail and IMAP watchers, Matrix direct mappings, Telegram progress, remote MCP startup, and managed llama.cpp startup on clean Windows hosts. (#161503, #160413, #161727, #161546, #162376, #163093) Thanks @obviyus, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @Ayushdevo, @addyCooks, @VACInc, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @RomneyDa.
- **Performance and UI continuity:** bound model-catalog waits, reduce Codex fleet heap pressure, and keep saved WebChat replies visible across history refresh races. (#161132, #162912, #162763) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @Flakedict, @obviyus, @609NFT, and @VACInc.

### Changes

- **Extended-stable release preparation:** align OpenClaw and every publishable official plugin to 2026.8.35 while preserving the 2026.8.34 publication contract.
- **Model compatibility:** add GPT-6.1 Sol to the branch-native OpenAI and Reef compatibility owners. (#161400, #162955)

### Fixes

- **Update safety:** preserve incompatible-plugin settings through recovery, keep retained plugin records during migration, avoid pnpm terminal failures, and carry the existing Gateway lock through container/direct startup. (#160344, #161485, #161920, #160193) Thanks @EndeavorPioneer, @aniruddhaadak80, @alkor2000, @xilopaint, and @grtninja.
- **Agent delivery:** recover uncapped cron replies, preserve complete CLI subagent answers, honor skipped announcements, retain detached transcripts, release suspended child slots, and keep failed requests from replacing earlier questions with a steer. (#160520, #162843, #161542, #161091, #162368, #162439) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @zyz619963502zyz, @holgergruenhagen, @armstrongsam25, @davidcittadini, and @obviyus.
- **Cron and tools:** bound thinking-catalog hydration, repair stale automatic tool snapshots without widening explicit allowlists, and deliver manual runs after their creating turn ends. (#161132, #162432, #162780) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @Flakedict, and @obviyus.
- **Sessions and tool results:** reject malformed session targets, preserve spawned working directories, project deeply nested MCP results safely, and keep remote MCP bundles working in native sessions. (#161533, #162308, #160825, #162376) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @Takhoffman, @hpyhandsome, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **Channels:** recover Gmail transient binds, bound IMAP backlog processing, restore Matrix direct mappings, and restore Telegram progress when hooks suppress previews. (#161503, #160413, #161727, #161546) Thanks @obviyus, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @Ayushdevo, @addyCooks, and @VACInc.
- **Runtime reliability:** prevent redaction stalls, cancel stale thinking-catalog waits, pass the responding agent to TTS model selection, stop durable worker retries from freezing hosts, reduce Codex fleet heap use, and install the required Visual C++ runtime after a managed llama.cpp launch failure. (#161089, #161319, #161454, #160812, #162912, #163093) Thanks @Baumus, @drakeo338, @aounakram, @RileyJJY, @aniruddhaadak80, @obviyus, @609NFT, and @RomneyDa.

版本从 0.23.0 提升至 0.23.1，仅版本字符串变更，API 快照、依赖、Python 支持和持久化模式均未改变
ai_summary.summary_cn: 此补丁版本（v0.23.1）主要修复了发布测试和发布就绪检查机制，确保测试循环初始化及必需检查的正确执行。同时调整了外部提供商测试的默认行为，改为需要维护者显式选择（opt-in）才能运行外部提供商场景。此外，该版本是 0.23 系列首次在 PyPI 发布，用户从 0.22.3 升级时将同时获得 0.23.0 的行为变更（如严格工具、审批恢复、加密历史、资源限制等）。

key_changes: 新增 MCP 列表页面的可配置显示数量限制
沙箱新增 Docker 移除保护（可选开启），并可配置内存整合轮次
会话功能新增加密历史扫描预算（可选开启）和压缩回滚条目预算
大量核心、沙箱、会话、语音、追踪及 MCP 模块的 Bug 修复与安全加固
默认语音转写模型更新为 gpt-transcribe
ai_summary.summary_cn: v0.23.0 是一次功能与稳定性并重的版本更新，新增了 MCP 列表页面上限、沙箱 Docker 移除保护和内存整合轮次配置、会话加密历史扫描预算等多项可配置能力。同时在核心（core）、沙箱（sandbox）、MCP、会话（sessions）、语音（voice）和追踪（tracing）等模块中完成了大量 Bug 修复和安全加固，包括敏感信息脱敏、嵌套代理工具状态隔离、WebSocket 握手重试、终端控制字符转义以及依赖升级等。默认语音转写模型也已切换为 gpt-transcribe。

releases.summary:
## [1.20.0] - 2026-10-02

### Added
- **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**: Host native workflows over Foundry Responses and Foundry Invocations ([#8947](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8947), [#8966](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8966))
- **agent-framework-duckdb**, **agent-framework-sql-server**, **agent-framework-typesafe**: Add DuckDB and SQL Server native vector-store connectors and the TypeSafe AI connector ([#8675](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8675), [#8686](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8686), [#8592](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8592))
- **agent-framework**, **agent-framework-core**: Add response-stream gates and buffering, session-scoped file-access isolation, an `AgentExecutor` checkpoint-state `TypedDict`, and opt-in `FunctionInvocationContext` injection for skill scripts ([#8829](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8829), [#8542](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8542), [#8284](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8284), [#8749](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8749))
- **agent-framework-foundry**, **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**, **agent-framework-openai**: Add native computer-use support to Responses clients and Foundry project embeddings ([#8751](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8751), [#8454](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8454))
- **agent-framework-azure-ai-search**: Support `knowledge_source_params` in `AzureAISearchContextProvider` ([#8673](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8673))
- **agent-framework-mongodb**, **samples**: Add a MongoDB agent RAG sample ([#8725](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8725))

### Changed
- **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**: [BREAKING] Redesign Foundry hosting around request-scoped agent factories, persistent sandbox-isolated sessions, parsed and durable Invocations runs, and configurable Responses history, background execution, and options ([#8372](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8372), [#8593](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8593), [#8741](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8741), [#8794](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8794), [#8894](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8894))
- **agent-framework-core**: Harden approval and MCP runtime context handling, treat matched function results as terminal, require session-backed local approvals, and fail closed when approval bindings or agent-tool approvals cannot be resolved ([#8579](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8579), [#8589](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8589), [#8750](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8750), [#8780](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8780), [#8527](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8527))
- **agent-framework-declarative**: [BREAKING - experimental] Align workflow state attribute lookup, bound PowerFx state construction, normalize workflow HTTP request URLs, and preserve expression results in `SendActivity` output ([#8893](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8893), [#8511](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8511), [#8588](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8588), [#8509](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8509))
- **agent-framework-gemini**, **agent-framework-core**: [BREAKING] Add Gemini Embedding 2 and vector task options, use the `GOOGLE_*` settings namespace, and support operation-specific embedding options in shared vector APIs ([#8798](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8798))
- **agent-framework-ag-ui**, **agent-framework-core**: Treat matched tool results as terminal; make disconnected AG-UI runs durable, emit `RUN_STARTED` before execution when IDs are supplied, and isolate custom approval-state namespaces ([#8579](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8579), [#8672](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8672), [#8807](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8807), [#8714](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8714))
- **agent-framework**, **agent-framework-core**: Bound the `all` integration set to the current release cohort to avoid pip resolver backtracking, and support `msgspec` 0.22 for Python 3.15 installations
- **agent-framework-a2a**, **agent-framework-anthropic**, **agent-framework-azure-contentunderstanding**, **agent-framework-azure-cosmos-memory**, **agent-framework-bedrock**, **agent-framework-claude**, **agent-framework-copilotstudio**, **agent-framework-declarative**, **agent-framework-devui**, **agent-framework-foundry**, **agent-framework-foundry-hosting**, **agent-framework-github-copilot**, **agent-framework-hosting**, **agent-framework-hosting-responses**, **agent-framework-hosting-telegram**, **agent-framework-mem0**, **agent-framework-purview**, **agent-framework-redis**: Add missing `py.typed` markers and enforce their presence in package checks ([#8823](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8823))
- **agent-framework-bedrock**: Forward Converse guardrail and additional-model-request options, send user images, and stream through ConverseStream ([#8680](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8680), [#8683](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8683), [#8685](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8685))
- **agent-framework-chatkit**: Support structured input and generated-image conversion ([#8843](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8843), [#8844](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8844))
- **agent-framework-orchestrations**: Create Magentic managers per workflow, optionally disable return-to-previous handoff routing, gate sequential output on approval, and validate generated handoffs before routing ([#8581](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8581), [#8639](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8639), [#8595](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8595), [#8587](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8587))
- **agent-framework-redis**: Allow `RedisHistoryProvider` to borrow a Redis client, clarify context-retrieval scope, and declare the current Python `<3.15` limit imposed by `redisvl` ([#8883](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8883), [#8584](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8584))
- **agent-framework-postgres**, **agent-framework-hyperlight**: Restore supported Python 3.15 dependency resolution ([#8505](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8505))
- **agent-framework-foundry**: Require Azure Monitor OpenTelemetry 1.8.10 for trace propagation and support Azure AI Projects through 2.7 ([#8512](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8512), [#8751](https://github.com/microsoft/agent-framework/pull/8751))

changes.description: 重新设计 Foundry 托管，改为基于请求作用域的代理工厂、持久化沙箱隔离会话和可解析的持久化 Invocations 运行，原有 API 不再兼容

breaking_changes.name: v3.51.1: security fixes for the pre-bash hook and MCP service destinations

changes.description: PreToolUse pre-bash 钩子拒绝命令时退出码从 1 改为 2，以真正阻止命令执行，行为不兼容
MCP 工具凭据仅发送到配置的服务地址，URL 参数仅作为断言，不再接受任意目标地址
默认语音 STT 模型改为 gpt-transcribe，需要显式覆盖旧模型设置
会话历史强制要求加密信封，未加密的历史记录不再被接受
严格工具参数、审批恢复、资源限制等行为变更，从 0.22.3 升级需遵循迁移指南

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本次分析的 15 个仓库中检测到 5 条强跨仓库共性信号，覆盖 30 个仓库，其中「agent 驱动的浏览器/UI 自动化操作报告成功但实际不生效」为最具普适性的问题（波及 30 仓、157 用例），「otel SDK 升级导致的 tracing 采集断裂」与「会话/沙箱运行时状态不同步」分别暴露了打包类与状态管理类的系统性问题，而「技能/工具列表硬编码上限且分页失效」「macOS arm64 安装环境二进制不兼容」则集中指向管道协议与安装链路缺陷。整体呈现「agent 运行时可靠性」与「打包/依赖兼容性」两大主导主题，建议优先修复跨仓库高优先级问题簇。
global_highlights: 跨仓库第一问题簇「agent/浏览器自动化操作报成功但 UI 不生效」波及 30 个仓库、157 个用例（P0，置信度 0.92），UI 运行时状态与 agent 能力就绪不同步是最普遍的根因，覆盖表格、导航、数据集加载等多类交互
打包与发布兼容性构成第二大跨仓库簇：arize-phoenix-otel 与 opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.0 不兼容使自托管 tracing 采集失效（P0、波及 9 仓），同一模式在 PyPI 缺 Windows 轮子、官方插件市场目录失效等信号中反复出现
会话/沙箱状态管理是跨仓库第三大簇（P0、波及 11 仓）：云会话恢复重试、运行时快照过期、资源上传被空缓存误拒绝，以及 query() 恢复后成本累计未清零导致重复计费的会话累计问题，凸显状态一致性是 agent 平台共同软肋
工具调用协议存在两类共性缺陷：beta.skills.list 硬编码 100 条上限且分页失效（P0、波及 13 仓）静默丢数据制造伪重复 400；多个 SDK 在工具 schema 序列化、structuredContent 空返回、typed 注解下误判参数上表现一致，均产生'报成功却拿空结果'的错误反馈闭环

top_pain_points.topic: PXI/agent 浏览器自动化操作报告成功但 UI 不生效或无法执行，阻断 agent 驱动的 UI 工作流
top_pain_points.summary: PXI agent 执行 UI 操作时，导航等操作返回成功但页面能力未就绪：数据集 selector 不随 PXI 加载而更新；navigation.goTo 成功跳转后 timeRange.set 仍返回 NOT_AVAILABLE，多次重试均无法完成设置，导致 agent 无法可靠地通过 UI 完成时间范围选择、数据集加载等操作。

top_pain_points.review_reason: agent 是 Phoenix PXI 的核心卖点，用户依赖 agent 自动完成 UI 操作。操作返回成功却未生效且反复重试不可达能力，直接导致 agent 驱动的自动化工作流断裂、需要人工介入，属明确的主流程/工作流失败。

source_issues.title: [bug] [agents] timeRange.set remains unavailable after navigation to a project traces page
source_issues.evidence: ui.navigation.goTo 返回 ok:true 后，ui.timeRange.set 连续 5 次 300ms 重试仍返回 NOT_AVAILABLE，跳转 traces 与 overview 均无法使操作生效，用户请求的 UI 动作被阻断。

source_issues.title: [bug][agents][playground] Dataset selector does not react to PXI dataset load
source_issues.evidence: PXI 加载数据集操作返回 loaded 成功，但 Playground 数据集 selector 不显示新数据集，UI 状态与实际不一致。

source_issues.title: Evaluator runs fail on mappings for variables removed from the template
source_issues.evidence: 模板移除变量后残留映射令服务端运行所有保存的变量映射，路径不匹配时整批评估失败，且错误命名了用户已不可见的输入，表单无行可修。

source_issues.title: ClassificationEvaluator raises a bare StopIteration for an empty choices mapping
source_issues.evidence: 空 choices {} 在构造时抛 str() 为空的 StopIteration，[] 则到渲染 prompt 后才在运行时被拒绝，缺少构造期清晰的参数校验。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Compact context always fails after exactly 60s — client-side timeout aborts a condensation the server then completes
source_issues.evidence: 脚本化复现：客户端在 60.01s 中止 POST，服务端 85s 后完成压缩并提交状态，但 UI 已报失败且上下文条不刷新；Ollama 慢模型下 1m57s 是常态。

source_issues.title: Compact Context fails with 405 Method Not Allowed
source_issues.evidence: 生产与 staging 上按压缩即 405，Cloud API 未暴露 /condense，路由到不具备该能力的 runtime，功能在云上不可用。

source_issues.title: Action fails on PRs with newly added files - git hash-object called before PR checkout
source_issues.evidence: 在 checkout PR 分支前于 fetchGitHubData()/prepareTagMode() 中对新增文件执行 git hash-object 失败,报错 'fatal: could not open ... No such file or directory'。任何包含新增文件的 PR 都会失败,无可用 workaround,用户只能改用本地 CLI,主流程阻断且复现明确。

source_issues.title: Automation mode stops at the first `result`; background subagents leave the review silently empty
source_issues.evidence: SDK runner 在第一条 result 消息处 break,而 run_in_background 子代理会带来 task_notification 与第二个 result。实测大 PR(100 文件,~12k diff)拆成 8 个后台代理后被 job 拆除,CLI 复现展示双 result 流,工作流绿但零审查评论且无任何报错。附 CLI 复现命令与真实运行日志。

source_issues.title: Inline-comment buffer uses a fixed /tmp path that leaks comments across runs (and repos) on self-hosted runners
source_issues.evidence: BUFFER_PATH 固定为 /tmp/inline-comments-buffer.jsonl 且发布后不删除。自托管共享 runner 上 repo B 的干净审查误发 repo A 残留评论,仅靠 GitHub 422 路径校验才未泄出到错误 PR,且该步骤失败使本来干净的审查失败。OAuth 无密钥时还会'posting all unconfirmed comments'放大泄露范围。附被抄袭的 workaround(rm -f)。

source_issues.title: macOS Cowork: Couldn't link this session to a computer since Desktop 2.9939.2 — Secure Enclave sign fails with OSStatus -25308
source_issues.evidence: Secure Enclave 签名失败 OSStatus -25308，每会话无法关联电脑，附着文件夹不可用，更新后仍复现。

top_pain_points.topic: arize-phoenix-otel 与 opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.0 不兼容，导致自托管用户的 tracing 采集失效

source_issues.title: remember: pin stale at 0.33.0 since the bump workflow was disabled; please advance to v0.36.0
source_issues.evidence: Three of them carry security fixes, including injection-guard bypasses and a gap in stripping credentials from untrusted config. Users who install only from this marketplace can't get them, and claude plugin update remember@claude-plugins-official tells them they are on the latest version.

source_issues.title: google-cloud-storage pin stale since the Sep 22 manual bumps; status of the new bump pipeline?
source_issues.evidence: The nightly Bump Plugin SHAs workflow has been disabled_manually since Sep 17 ... As of Sep 294 no bump PRs have been opened since then, so plugins whose sources changed after those batches are stuck on their old pins.

source_issues.title: clawhub package publish of a 17 KB code-plugin fails server-side: Node.js action execution ran out of memory (512 MB)
source_issues.evidence: 发布 17KB 代码插件 0.3.0，3/3 次确定性复现 Node.js action 内存耗尽（512MB 上限），dry-run/validate 通过，同载荷 0.2.1 8 月可正常发布，错误由后端提出而非 CLI。

source_issues.title: Skill publish fails with Server Error after 7-11 min and the version is never created
source_issues.evidence: 发布 10MB skill 4.3.0，两次尝试分别 10 分 41 秒和 7 分 16 秒后返回裸 Server Error，轮询 40 分钟版本始终 404，4.2.1 同管线 4 天前可发布；并指出发布非幂等，慢请求成功落库后回客户端仍是失败。

source_issues.title: Package publish returns bare 500 for staged ClawPacks above ~24 MB unpacked
source_issues.evidence: 发布 13.4MB ClawPack（展开 35.7MiB）每次失败返回 500，多个 request id；同包剪到 12.6MB 即成功，广告的 50MiB 上限因 gunzip/tar 拷贝无法触及，实际可行上限约 24MB。

source_issues.title: clawdhub@latest STILL points to broken 0.3.0 tarball (undici missing) — recurrence of #2315
source_issues.evidence: npx clawdhub@latest --cli-version 直接抛 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'undici'；OpenClaw 自动更新任务因此失败并向终端用户暴露 'Skills update failed'；latest dist-tag 4 个月未修复，稳定修复只在 beta。

top_pain_points.topic: 云会话沙箱恢复与运行时状态不同步，导致恢复/上传失败
top_pain_points.summary: 云会话暂停后自动恢复只尝试一次且把 id 提前标记为已恢复，瞬时失败(429/499/502)后永久不再重试直到重新挂载/刷新；取消暂停的乐观写入还会触发暂停→立即恢复竞态；附件上传因缓存空串覆盖有效运行时而在就绪沙箱上误报 '沙箱仍在启动'。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 云订阅用户返回暂停会话可能直接无法继续、或上传失败并被错误提示误导去重试，属于对关键会话流程的真实破坏。

source_issues.title: Cloud conversations fail to resume reliably after sandbox pause
source_issues.evidence: Datadog 显示 pause→resume 序列中 resume 返回 502，且 resumeTriggeredForRef 在请求成功前就置位，瞬时失败后 route 不再重试，暂停会话在本 route 生命周期内无法恢复。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Cloud attachment upload rejects valid runtime data when cached fields are empty strings
source_issues.evidence: 缓存对象里 conversation_url/session_api_key 为空串时被 ?? 合并回来覆盖新鲜查询结果，导致已被 provision 好的沙箱被误判为'仍在启动'，用户被迫重试本可成功的上传。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Active conversation keeps stale runtime details after a same-status refetch
source_issues.evidence: useActiveConversation 同步 effect 未把 query.data 列为依赖，同 execution_status 的刷新后 ConversationService 快照仍是旧 URL/key/工作目录，让上传、轨迹、VS Code 等消费者持续指向旧运行时。

source_issues.title: A corrupt transcript line aborts import_session_to_store mid-write, leaving a partial session
source_issues.evidence: import_session_to_store 以未受保护的 json.loads(line) 逐批写入，单条损坏行在早期批次已提交后中止导入，留下缺失末条消息的残段会话，resume 会静默打开无此记录。

source_issues.title: Session store writes and reads derive project_key differently, so a git-worktree session lists and resumes as empty
source_issues.evidence: SessionStore 写路径按磁盘目录名、读路径按 sanitized hash 推导 project_key 不同，git worktree 中的会话 list_sessions_from_store 返回 [] 且 resume 静默开启全新会话，历史就此丢失。

source_issues.title: Session summary parser skips ordinary user text equal to tool_result
source_issues.evidence: _extract_first_prompt_from_head 在原始 JSON 串中按词匹配 'tool_result'，把普通用户文本 tool_result 当成工具响应块，导致 get_session_info_from_store 返回 None、first_prompt 丢失或被后续提示词顶替。

source_issues.title: 0.3.277 made total_cost_usd / modelUsage session-cumulative on resume; no per-query() usage is left for hosts that meter individual turns
source_issues.evidence: 升级后每个后续轮次都被按其所在整个对话累计成本计费，某合并请求一天六个跟进轮次记 $8.95、$11.77、$12.63、$13.52、$18.30、$21.46，而按 per-message usage 实际约 $3；日总 $669 对约 $310 实际用量。result.usage 只覆盖最后一条 API 调用且输出 token 部分，per-message usage is 部分值，get_usage/get_session_cost 未暴露到 Query，宿主无法自行修复，只能持久化上次累计值再相减。

source_issues.title: fix(subagent): escalate timeout to the process group so detached grandchildren are reaped
source_issues.evidence: 超时升级只杀直接 CLI 子进程，子进程共享父进程组无法 killpg；CLI 对 SIGTERM 无响应被 SIGKILL 时其分离的后台子进程被孤儿化继续运行，正是 #4075 旨在消除的泄漏，仅在不响应路径残留。

source_issues.title: ToolNode silently drops Command.update when a tool returns Command(graph=PARENT, goto=[Send(...)])
source_issues.evidence: 工具返回 Command(PARENT, Send列表)时 update(含 ToolMessage/AIMessage)被静默丢弃,父状态无委派记录,生产 agent 触发无界 delegate 循环直至 GraphRecursionError(60 次委派,~1小时,1500万 tokens)。

source_issues.title: Command(resume={...}) with 32-hex keys that match no pending interrupt id is silently ignored
source_issues.evidence: uuid4().hex(32 hex)作为 resume map key 匹配不到 pending interrupt 时被静默吞掉,线程保持 interrupted,UI 认为已审批但 action 从未执行。

top_pain_points.topic: beta.skills.list 硬编码 100 条上限且分页失效，导致技能枚举静默丢数据、create 报伪重复 400、无法清理可见范围外的技能
top_pain_points.summary: client.beta.skills.list 无论 limit 取多少最多返回 100 条，且 has_more 恒为 false、无可用游标，超过 100 条的技能无法访问。作者环境约 120 个技能，靠 list 对账的流程会漏取已有技能，进而在 create 时收到 duplicate display_title 400（冲突实际在不可见的尾部），又因看不到该技能的 skill_id 而无法 delete。作者被迫用临时 workaround 才能继续，且每次对账都会浪费一次删除。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 真实用户主流程（技能清单对账/失效技能回收）被本 bug 阻断并造成静默数据不一致：list 结果不完整直接导致 create 报伪冲突、delete 目标不可见，必须靠临时且脆弱的 workaround，属于明确的用户可感知功能不可用。

source_issues.title: beta.skills.list hard-capped at 100 items with broken pagination (has_more always false, no cursor)
source_issues.evidence: 列出 5 种 limit 实测均返回 100 条；has_more 恒为 false，无游标参数可用，手工 after_id 也不生效。作者 120 技能环境对账脚本静默漏取→create 触发伪 duplicate 400→无法按 skill_id 删除，需用脆弱 workaround 每次浪费一次删除。

source_issues.title: TextEvent.parsed_snapshot() raises ValueError on ordinary text (and on the empty first delta), and its return annotation is wrong for non-object JSON
source_issues.evidence: 内置复现：snapshot='Hello, world!' 与 '' 均抛 ValueError；'[1,2]' 返回 list 却注解 Dict。该事件对每个文本 delta 都会发出，正常判断 ev.type==text 后无条件调用即可在首个事件崩溃。

source_issues.title: HookEvent names 10 of the CLI's hook events; SessionStartHookSpecificOutput is exported for an event the literal cannot register
source_issues.evidence: HookEvent 仅 10 个事件名，而 TS union 有 33 个；SessionStart 钩子在运行时被接受并到达 CLI，但类型检查失败——类型与运行时不符。

source_issues.title: list_sessions has no includeProgrammatic filter, get_session_messages has no includeSystemMessages, and SessionMessage.type cannot be 'system'
source_issues.evidence: Python list_sessions 缺 includeProgrammatic，get_session_messages 缺 includeSystemMessages，_is_visible_message 仅允许 user/assistant 而 type 字面量不含 system，无法返回系统消息。

source_issues.title: elicitation and request_user_dialog control requests are answered with an error; supportedDialogKinds and perTaskStopAffordance are never sent
source_issues.evidence: 对 elicitation/request_user_dialog 控制请求返回 'Unsupported control request subtype' 错误，且不声明 supportedDialogKinds/perTaskStopAffordance，主机无法参与这些流程，中断时后台任务被终止。

source_issues.title: MCP TypedDict schemas misclassify Required/NotRequired under postponed annotations
source_issues.evidence: 重现：from __future__ import annotations + TypedDict 中 NotRequired 参数被写入 required 数组，调用 {"query":"test"} 返回 isError=true 'limit' is a required property，处理函数不执行；反向 Required 亦然。普通 module-level future import 即会让可选参数变必填，拒绝合法调用。

source_issues.title: @tool builds an empty input schema, with no error, for an input_schema it does not recognize (typing_extensions.TypedDict on Python 3.11 and later)
source_issues.evidence: Python 3.11+ 下 typing_extensions.TypedDict 类被 is_typeddict 识别失败，_build_input_schema 静默返回空 properties，工具以无参数注册且无警告；同一类用 typing.TypedDict 则有完整 schema。

source_issues.title: Cross-version zod schemas crash tools/list in createSdkMcpServer (connected but zero tools)
source_issues.evidence: z.record() 由 zod 4.6.5 构造，但包内置 4.4.3 的 context 没有 deferred 字段，walker 抛出 TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push')；抛错发生在工具列表序列化时，整个 tools/list 响应失败，服务器被报告为 connected 且零工具，属静默的难归因失败。

source_issues.title: Plugins from this marketplace fail to load ("conflicting manifests") after every Claude Desktop marketplace refresh
source_issues.evidence: 原文日志显示每次 refresh 都 synthesize 三个 manifest，被 rejection 后 academy-guide/academy-guide、claude-api/claude-api、discernment-nudge/discernment-nudge 从新会话 skill listing 消失；claude plugin update 仅临时恢复，下次 Desktop 刷新又坏（2026-09-12 至 10-01 六次刷新全部重现）。

source_issues.title: MCP tool answering in `structuredContent` is a success with an empty result
source_issues.evidence: 11 评论：MCP 工具按规范返回 structuredContent 时被误判为成功，模型收到空的 functionResponse，终端无任何输出，工具真实结果完全丢失。

top_pain_points.topic: macOS arm64 安装环境下 aider 因 scipy _propack 二进制不兼容在生成仓库地图时直接崩溃
top_pain_points.summary: 大量用户在 macOS arm64 平台运行 aider 0.86.2 时,在生成仓库地图(repo map)阶段触发 scipy sparse `_propack` 动态库加载失败(`dlopen ... __DATA/__thread_bss zero-fill section type, offset field is not zero`),抛出未捕获 ImportError,会话直接终止。报错链路完全一致(`repomap.py -> nx.pagerank -> scipy`),是 scipy 二进制与 pipx/uv 安装环境不兼容导致的普遍崩溃。
top_pain_points.review_reason: 多个独立用户在不同 macOS arm64 安装环境(pipx/uv)下遇到完全一致的未捕获 ImportError,会话在生成仓库地图(核心分析流程)阶段直接崩溃,属于主流程阻断,附带的链接均为真实请求。

signals.topic: PXI/agent 浏览器自动化操作报告成功但 UI 不生效或无法执行，阻断 agent 驱动的 UI 工作流
signals.summary: PXI agent 执行 UI 操作时，导航等操作返回成功但页面能力未就绪：数据集 selector 不随 PXI 加载而更新；navigation.goTo 成功跳转后 timeRange.set 仍返回 NOT_AVAILABLE，多次重试均无法完成设置，导致 agent 无法可靠地通过 UI 完成时间范围选择、数据集加载等操作。
signals.review_reason: agent 是 Phoenix PXI 的核心卖点，用户依赖 agent 自动完成 UI 操作。操作返回成功却未生效且反复重试不可达能力，直接导致 agent 驱动的自动化工作流断裂、需要人工介入，属明确的主流程/工作流失败。

source_issues.title: [bug] [agents] timeRange.set remains unavailable after navigation to a project traces page
source_issues.evidence: ui.navigation.goTo 返回 ok:true 后，ui.timeRange.set 连续 5 次 300ms 重试仍返回 NOT_AVAILABLE，跳转 traces 与 overview 均无法使操作生效，用户请求的 UI 动作被阻断。

source_issues.title: [bug][agents][playground] Dataset selector does not react to PXI dataset load
source_issues.evidence: PXI 加载数据集操作返回 loaded 成功，但 Playground 数据集 selector 不显示新数据集，UI 状态与实际不一致。

signals.topic: Online evals 评估器管理 UI 存在保存/选中阻塞缺陷，导致评估器无法正常管理与使用
signals.summary: 在线评估（online evals）的评估器管理界面存在两个独立缺陷：复制评估器时名称被加入空格导致名称校验失败、副本无法保存；评估画廊打开时自动选中第一个评估器且无法取消选中，造成狗食测试中所有参与者困惑。
signals.review_reason: 评估器是 Phoenix 在线评估功能的入口，复制后无法保存与无法取消选中的缺陷会反复阻塞用户创建/配置评估器的操作，造成体验显著下降且需额外手动操作绕过。

source_issues.title: [online evals] duplicating an evaluator adds a space to its name and it can't be saved
source_issues.evidence: 复制评估器后副本名称含空格，触发名称校验失败，必须手动重命名才能保存。

source_issues.title: [online evals] eval gallery auto-selects the first evaluator and it can't be unselected
source_issues.evidence: 画廊打开即自动选中第一个预置评估器且无法清除选择，狗食测试中全员困惑，影响评估器选择与配置流程。

signals.topic: 评估器在边界/异常配置下运行或构造时失败（模板变量残留映射、空 choices 抛出裸 StopIteration）
signals.summary: 评估流程对异常配置缺乏健壮处理：从模板移除变量后残留的路径映射会在运行时导致评估失败且错误指向用户不可见的输入、表单无法修复；ClassificationEvaluator 对空 choices 映射在构造时抛出空消息的裸 StopIteration，空列表则延迟到运行时才失败。
signals.review_reason: 评估器在用户可遇到的正常操作序列（编辑模板、配置 choices）下失败或抛出难以理解的异常，会中断评估任务执行并耗费用户排障时间，属评估主流程的可用性缺陷。

source_issues.title: Evaluator runs fail on mappings for variables removed from the template
source_issues.evidence: 模板移除变量后残留映射令服务端运行所有保存的变量映射，路径不匹配时整批评估失败，且错误命名了用户已不可见的输入，表单无行可修。

source_issues.title: ClassificationEvaluator raises a bare StopIteration for an empty choices mapping
source_issues.evidence: 空 choices {} 在构造时抛 str() 为空的 StopIteration，[] 则到渲染 prompt 后才在运行时被拒绝，缺少构造期清晰的参数校验。

signals.topic: Token 计费/成本统计因非有限 token 数值被清零，导致成本数据错误或丢失
signals.summary: OTLP span 可能携带 NaN/infinity 的 token count。span 解码器的聚合逻辑（get_aggregated_tokens）对三个字段共用一次 int()，任一字段为非有限值会令全部计数返回 (0,0,0)，把其他两个字段的有效计费数据一并丢弃，SpanCostDetailsCalculator 据此给出错误的成本明细。
signals.review_reason: 成本/token 统计是用户观测和核算 LLM 用量的关键功能，一个非有限字段就抹掉全部计数，会让成本图表和统计出现明显错误，误导成本归因与预算判断。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Non-finite token count zeroes valid counts in cost calculation
source_issues.evidence: get_aggregated_tokens 对含 NaN 的 prompt 计数与其他有效字段一起返回 (0,0,0)，丢失 completion=7 与 total=11 的有效计数，成本计算基于零值。

signals.topic: arize-phoenix-otel 与 opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.0 不兼容，导致自托管用户的 tracing 采集失效
signals.summary: arize-phoenix-otel v0.17.1 依赖的导出器内部直接用 _headers 属性，新版本 opentelemetry-sdk 移除了该属性，导致 tracing 详情/导出逻辑在 opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.0 环境下无法按预期工作，自托管用户升级 SDK 后采集中断。
signals.review_reason: 依赖上界缺失导致自托管用户升级到新版 opentelemetry-sdk 后 OTEL 集成直接不可用，阻断正常的 trace 数据上报，是明确的兼容性/可安装性断裂问题。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: arize-phoenix-otel v0.17.1 does not work with opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.0
source_issues.evidence: self-hosted 场景下,HTTPSpanExporter 不再具有 _headers 属性,导入/导出及 tracing 详情逻辑在 opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.0 下失效。

signals.topic: 修改 LLM 模型或切换/编辑 profile 时凭据或 base_url 被清空，导致对话鉴权失败无法回复
signals.summary: 在设置里只改模型不重新输入 API key 会把已存 key 覆盖成空字符串，或切换指向 provider connection 的 profile 时后端不解析已存凭据，以及编辑连接 base_url 后新对话仍用旧快照——三种路径都会在发送消息时触发 AuthenticationError/405，直接阻断对话。
signals.review_reason: 用户最常见的操作——改模型/切换 profile——就会抹掉已存凭据或沿用过期配置，发送消息直接 AuthenticationError/405 阻断主流程，且报错信息不指出根因；这是真实反复发生的用户可用性痛点。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Changing LLM model without re-typing the API key wipes the stored key (auth errors on profile switch)
source_issues.evidence: API key 输入框从不回填已存 secret，用户只改 model 保存时字段为空字符串，被后端 deep_merge 当成覆盖写掉真实 key；切到该 profile 即报 LLMAuthenticationError，复现步骤和根因代码均已给出。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Switching to an OpenRouter profile linked to a provider connection loses API credentials
source_issues.evidence: 切换 profile 的 switch_llm 请求返回 200，但服务端未解析 provider_connection_id，后续消息报 OpenrouterException 401 'No cookie auth credentials found'，用户被要求重复填 key 或提供 cookie 才能用。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Editing provider-connection base_url does not take effect on next conversation (stale snapshot in settings.json)
source_issues.evidence: 修好 provider connection 的 base_url 后新对话仍走 settings.json 里的旧快照，得到未改动的 LiteLLM 405，且没有任何'用了旧配置'的信号，用户无头绪排查。

signals.topic: 云会话沙箱恢复与运行时状态不同步，导致恢复/上传失败
signals.summary: 云会话暂停后自动恢复只尝试一次且把 id 提前标记为已恢复，瞬时失败(429/499/502)后永久不再重试直到重新挂载/刷新；取消暂停的乐观写入还会触发暂停→立即恢复竞态；附件上传因缓存空串覆盖有效运行时而在就绪沙箱上误报 '沙箱仍在启动'。
signals.review_reason: 云订阅用户返回暂停会话可能直接无法继续、或上传失败并被错误提示误导去重试，属于对关键会话流程的真实破坏。

source_issues.title: Cloud conversations fail to resume reliably after sandbox pause
source_issues.evidence: Datadog 显示 pause→resume 序列中 resume 返回 502，且 resumeTriggeredForRef 在请求成功前就置位，瞬时失败后 route 不再重试，暂停会话在本 route 生命周期内无法恢复。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Cloud attachment upload rejects valid runtime data when cached fields are empty strings
source_issues.evidence: 缓存对象里 conversation_url/session_api_key 为空串时被 ?? 合并回来覆盖新鲜查询结果，导致已被 provision 好的沙箱被误判为'仍在启动'，用户被迫重试本可成功的上传。

source_issues.title: [Bug] Active conversation keeps stale runtime details after a same-status refetch
source_issues.evidence: useActiveConversation 同步 effect 未把 query.data 列为依赖，同 execution_status 的刷新后 ConversationService 快照仍是旧 URL/key/工作目录，让上传、轨迹、VS Code 等消费者持续指向旧运行时。

signals.topic: 本地/自托管部署的会话密钥与远程访问存在凭据暴露风险
signals.summary: 默认本地模式把会话 API key 注入前端并绑定全部接口，LAN/隧道/公网可达时任何对端都能取得凭据；自托管用 LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY 配置鉴权时 entrypoint 未导出给 agent-server，鉴权直接被打穿；VS Code 打开动作缺 noopener 且不校验 URL 协议，可被反向 tabnabbing 劫持已打开的 Canvas 页。
signals.review_reason: 自托管/本地用户可能无意中把 agent-server 凭据暴露给 LAN 或公网，甚至配置了自定义密钥却处于完全无鉴权状态，同时会话页可能被恶意页面劫持，均是真实且影响面大的安全隐患。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Local stack exposes the session API key to LAN peers — static server and ingress bind all interfaces while injecting the key into index.html
source_issues.evidence: Vite server.host:true、静态服务器绑定 '::'、ingress 无 host 监听，把 VITE_SESSION_API_KEY / window.__AGENT_CANVAS_SESSION_API_KEY__ 注入前端，同一 LAN 的对端即可取得并调用被代理的 agent-server API。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Self-hosted LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY is not exported to OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0 in entrypoint.sh, causing agent-server auth bypass
source_issues.evidence: entrypoint.sh 只在'未提供 key'分支导出 OH_SESSION_API_KEYS_0；用户自定义 LOCAL_BACKEND_API_KEY 时该块被跳过，config.session_api_keys 为空，所有 /api/* 路由鉴权检查无条件放行。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Reverse tabnabbing in conversation card's VS Code action — window.open without noopener plus scheme-agnostic URL transformer
source_issues.evidence: conversation-card 的 'Download via VS Code' 用 window.open(url,'_blank') 无 noopener，transformVSCodeUrl 对非 http(s) 协议原样放行，被攻击的后端值可劫持原 Canvas 标签页做伪装登录页。已含合规参照实现 drawer-vscode-link.tsx。

signals.topic: Compact Context 压缩上下文失败（客户端 60s 超时 / 云路由 405）
signals.summary: 压缩大上下文在慢模型上超过 60s 被客户端超时中止并报失败，实际后端已完成但上下文条永不刷新；云环境上因路由到不含 /condense 的端点直接 405，功能均不可用。
signals.review_reason: 压缩/整理上下文是长对话的核心功能，在慢模型与云环境下稳定失败，用户既压缩不了也收不到正确反馈，属于明确的功能阻断。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Compact context always fails after exactly 60s — client-side timeout aborts a condensation the server then completes
source_issues.evidence: 脚本化复现：客户端在 60.01s 中止 POST，服务端 85s 后完成压缩并提交状态，但 UI 已报失败且上下文条不刷新；Ollama 慢模型下 1m57s 是常态。

source_issues.title: Compact Context fails with 405 Method Not Allowed
source_issues.evidence: 生产与 staging 上按压缩即 405，Cloud API 未暴露 /condense，路由到不具备该能力的 runtime，功能在云上不可用。

signals.topic: Windows 本地后端下 Files 与 Planner 面板完全不可用
signals.summary: Canvas 假设本地 agent-server 是 POSIX：Files 卡片用 find|head 管线（cmd.exe 下 exit 255），Planner 用只认 POSIX 路径的 normalizeAbsolutePath/requirePathInsideDirectory，导致 Windows 上两个面板对每个会话都报错或显示空态。
signals.review_reason: Windows 是主流桌面平台，Files 与 Planner 是会话协作的核心面板，在 Windows 本地模式下对所有会话都失效，属于跨一整个平台的关键功能不可用。

source_issues.title: [Bug]:  Files tab always shows "No files in workspace" on Windows local backend
source_issues.evidence: POST /api/bash/execute_bash_command 的 find 管线在 cmd.exe 下 exit 255，Files 标签对每个本地会话都显示'No files in workspace'，即便文件存在且 agent 能读写。

source_issues.title: [Bug]: Planner tab fails with "Conversation file path must stay inside the workspace" on Windows local backend
source_issues.evidence: Windows 下工作目录是盘符路径（如 C:\... 或 D:\tese），normalizeAbsolutePath 只接受以 / 开头而返回 null，requirePathInsideDirectory 恒抛错，Planner 对每个本地会话都失败、不发请求。

signals.topic: beta.skills.list 硬编码 100 条上限且分页失效，导致技能枚举静默丢数据、create 报伪重复 400、无法清理可见范围外的技能
signals.summary: client.beta.skills.list 无论 limit 取多少最多返回 100 条，且 has_more 恒为 false、无可用游标，超过 100 条的技能无法访问。作者环境约 120 个技能，靠 list 对账的流程会漏取已有技能，进而在 create 时收到 duplicate display_title 400（冲突实际在不可见的尾部），又因看不到该技能的 skill_id 而无法 delete。作者被迫用临时 workaround 才能继续，且每次对账都会浪费一次删除。
signals.review_reason: 真实用户主流程（技能清单对账/失效技能回收）被本 bug 阻断并造成静默数据不一致：list 结果不完整直接导致 create 报伪冲突、delete 目标不可见，必须靠临时且脆弱的 workaround，属于明确的用户可感知功能不可用。

source_issues.title: beta.skills.list hard-capped at 100 items with broken pagination (has_more always false, no cursor)
source_issues.evidence: 列出 5 种 limit 实测均返回 100 条；has_more 恒为 false，无游标参数可用，手工 after_id 也不生效。作者 120 技能环境对账脚本静默漏取→create 触发伪 duplicate 400→无法按 skill_id 删除，需用脆弱 workaround 每次浪费一次删除。

signals.topic: TextEvent.parsed_snapshot() 对普通非 JSON 文本（含首个空 delta）抛 ValueError，且返回注解错误
signals.summary: TextEvent.parsed_snapshot()/ParsedBetaTextEvent.parsed_snapshot() 未加守卫直接对累计文本跑 jiter.from_json：对普通文本 delta 抛 ValueError，对文本块起始的空 snapshot 也抛 EOF 错误，而这两者正是该事件最普遍的用法；对非对象 JSON 又返回 list/str 却注解为 Dict[str, Any]。调用方无条件调用即崩溃，API 未提示需先判空。
signals.review_reason: 文本流场景下首个事件即抛异常、普通文本也抛，是正常调用路径上的崩溃脚爪；虽有守卫可绕开，但 API 未提示，会对使用结构化输出流式方法的用户造成运行时异常与类型误导，属可感知的 SDK 使用痛点。

source_issues.title: TextEvent.parsed_snapshot() raises ValueError on ordinary text (and on the empty first delta), and its return annotation is wrong for non-object JSON
source_issues.evidence: 内置复现：snapshot='Hello, world!' 与 '' 均抛 ValueError；'[1,2]' 返回 list 却注解 Dict。该事件对每个文本 delta 都会发出，正常判断 ev.type==text 后无条件调用即可在首个事件崩溃。

signals.topic: Messages 流式：当前回合含 tool_result 时后续正文被缓存数秒后一次性涌出，聊天 UI 表现为长时间卡顿后突然出现
signals.summary: 在 claude-sonnet-5-5 上，当对话最新内容为 tool_result 时，回复不会边生成边流式返回，而是停顿约 5 秒后前 ~2000 字一次性到达，随后才正常流式输出。默认设置及最低 thinking 均复现，无法关闭，claude-sonnet-5 同样请求则正常。memory 工具会在每次首答前触发此行为，导致聊天 UI 中每次工具调用后的回答都像被卡死数秒再整段出现。
signals.review_reason: 聊天 UI 场景下工具调用后的回答表现为数秒卡顿后整段弹出，用户体验显著下降，尤其 memory 工具使每次对话首答都触发；虽根因在 Messages API 侧且有规避手段，但作为流式核心痛点被直接上报到本 SDK 仓库，用户影响明确。

source_issues.title: Messages API: text after a tool_result is held for several seconds, then sent in one burst (claude-sonnet-5-5)
source_issues.evidence: 表格实证：case A history 以 tool_result 结尾时 text 到 5.2s 才全部输出，而对照 case D 纯文本 0.8s→4.8s 正常流式；A 在 claude-sonnet-5 上 1.1s→6.4s 正常。memory 工具使每次首答被 hold。影响：工具调用后的每次回答在 UI 上数秒卡顿然后整段弹出。

signals.topic: 会话语义/导入缺失与内容被误判，导致会话元数据丢失或不一致
signals.summary: 会话存储对 corrupt transcript 行导入中途失败留下残段、git worktree 会话因 project_key 推导不一致而列出/续接为空、以及普通文本 tool_result 被误判为工具响应块导致 first_prompt 丢失或元数据消失。
signals.review_reason: 会话语义类问题导致用户核心会话数据不可用：worktree 会话续接静默开启空会话（历史丢失但无错误提示），损坏 transcript 导入留下残缺会话且不报文件/行号，普通文本被误判则使 first_prompt/元数据消失。多为边缘触发（worktree、损坏日志、恰为 tool_result 的文本），非高频主流程，故为 P2。

source_issues.title: A corrupt transcript line aborts import_session_to_store mid-write, leaving a partial session
source_issues.evidence: import_session_to_store 以未受保护的 json.loads(line) 逐批写入，单条损坏行在早期批次已提交后中止导入，留下缺失末条消息的残段会话，resume 会静默打开无此记录。

source_issues.title: Session store writes and reads derive project_key differently, so a git-worktree session lists and resumes as empty
source_issues.evidence: SessionStore 写路径按磁盘目录名、读路径按 sanitized hash 推导 project_key 不同，git worktree 中的会话 list_sessions_from_store 返回 [] 且 resume 静默开启全新会话，历史就此丢失。

source_issues.title: Session summary parser skips ordinary user text equal to tool_result
source_issues.evidence: _extract_first_prompt_from_head 在原始 JSON 串中按词匹配 'tool_result'，把普通用户文本 tool_result 当成工具响应块，导致 get_session_info_from_store 返回 None、first_prompt 丢失或被后续提示词顶替。

signals.topic: SDK 缺少对 CLI 端支持的多类事件/能力/过滤器的实现，导致钩子、会话查询与用户对话框等能力在 Python 侧不可用
signals.summary: Python SDK 与同源 TS SDK 能力存在落差：HookEvent 仅含 10 个事件（注册 SessionStart 运行时不限但类型检查拒绝）、list_sessions 无 includeProgrammatic、get_session_messages 无 includeSystemMessages 且 type 不含 system、elicitation/request_user_dialog 控制请求直接返回错误并导致后台任务在中断时被终止。
signals.review_reason: 以上三条为 Python/TS SDK 能力不对等导致的可用性缺陷。SessionStart 等钩子注册在类型检查与运行时行为上相互矛盾（用户按文档写上就过不了 mypy），会话/系统消息查询缺少对应过滤器与类型，elicitation 与 request_user_dialog 直接报错且触发后台任务在中断时被终止。均为真实用户在执行 agent 工作流/集成会话能力时遭遇的功能不可用，但非主流程崩溃，故 P2。

source_issues.title: HookEvent names 10 of the CLI's hook events; SessionStartHookSpecificOutput is exported for an event the literal cannot register
source_issues.evidence: HookEvent 仅 10 个事件名，而 TS union 有 33 个；SessionStart 钩子在运行时被接受并到达 CLI，但类型检查失败——类型与运行时不符。

source_issues.title: list_sessions has no includeProgrammatic filter, get_session_messages has no includeSystemMessages, and SessionMessage.type cannot be 'system'
source_issues.evidence: Python list_sessions 缺 includeProgrammatic，get_session_messages 缺 includeSystemMessages，_is_visible_message 仅允许 user/assistant 而 type 字面量不含 system，无法返回系统消息。

source_issues.title: elicitation and request_user_dialog control requests are answered with an error; supportedDialogKinds and perTaskStopAffordance are never sent
source_issues.evidence: 对 elicitation/request_user_dialog 控制请求返回 'Unsupported control request subtype' 错误，且不声明 supportedDialogKinds/perTaskStopAffordance，主机无法参与这些流程，中断时后台任务被终止。

signals.topic: TypedDict 工具参数在延迟注解下被错误识别为必填/可选，导致有效参数被拒绝、MCP 工具 schema 错误且定义 @tool 时不被察觉
signals.summary: MCP TypedDict 工具在 from __future__ import annotations 下，可选参数被误判为必填（拒绝本应有效调用），Required/NotRequired 反转，且@tool 对未识别的 typing_extensions.TypedDict 静默构建空 schema，无任何报错。
signals.review_reason: 直接阻断工具调用主流程：可选参数被误判为必填会导致本应成功的调用在 handler 执行前即被校验拒绝，而缺失参数的反向错误会放行不完整调用；更隐蔽的是@tool 对无法识别的 schema 静默降级为空 schema，用户无任何报错地得到无参数工具。两条 issue 均给出可复现脚本并有明确测试断言（isError 翻转、调用被拒）。

source_issues.title: MCP TypedDict schemas misclassify Required/NotRequired under postponed annotations
source_issues.evidence: 重现：from __future__ import annotations + TypedDict 中 NotRequired 参数被写入 required 数组，调用 {"query":"test"} 返回 isError=true 'limit' is a required property，处理函数不执行；反向 Required 亦然。普通 module-level future import 即会让可选参数变必填，拒绝合法调用。

source_issues.title: @tool builds an empty input schema, with no error, for an input_schema it does not recognize (typing_extensions.TypedDict on Python 3.11 and later)
source_issues.evidence: Python 3.11+ 下 typing_extensions.TypedDict 类被 is_typeddict 识别失败，_build_input_schema 静默返回空 properties，工具以无参数注册且无警告；同一类用 typing.TypedDict 则有完整 schema。

signals.topic: 配置/settings 异常在静默丢弃与裸异常之间不一致，导致用户配置在无提示下丢失或得到非领域化报错
signals.summary: ClaudeAgentOptions.settings 的内联 JSON 字符串解析失败时被静默当成文件路径丢弃（仅打印误导性日志），无 sandbox 时才透传；而相同字节作为文件读取时抛裸 JSONDecodeError 而非 CLIConnectionError，破坏 SDK 错误层级。
signals.review_reason: 配置型缺陷会静默丢失用户关键配置（模型、权限、env、hooks），且运行看似正常，用户难以察觉正是最危险之处；且错误类型破坏了 SDK 的 ClaudeSDKError 层级，令调用方捕获逻辑失效。为真实用户配置编排中的体验/可靠性问题，但属单个 issue 且非常规主流程，故 P2。

source_issues.title: Malformed inline settings is silently discarded with sandbox; the file form raises a bare JSONDecodeError
source_issues.evidence: 格式错误的 settings 内联 JSON 被当作文件路径静默丢弃，运行看似正常，模型/权限/env/hooks 全部丢失，仅打印一行把 JSON 文本当文件名的误导警告；文件形式则抛裸 json.JSONDecodeError 而非 CLIConnectionError。

signals.topic: PyPI 缺少 Windows 轮子，导致 Windows 用户无法升级 SDK 或被阻断于旧版本
signals.summary: SDK 0.2.160 至最新 0.2.163 在 PyPI 上没有 win_amd64 wheel（最后一个有 Windows 轮子的是 0.2.159），含已知修复的用户无法升级至最新版。
signals.review_reason: Windows 平台的用户会因缺少 win_amd64 wheel 而无法安装/升级最新 SDK（潜在依赖 fallback 或卡在旧版），这是阻断性发布质量问题。报告人明确表示被阻断升级，属真实用户影响，但单仓单 issue 且影响面限定 Windows，故 P2。

source_issues.title: PyPI has no win_amd64 wheel for SDK 0.2.160 through latest 0.2.163
source_issues.evidence: 0.2.159 是最后一个有 Windows 轮子的版本，0.2.160–0.2.163 均无 win_amd64 wheel，作者明确表示这阻断了他们升级 agent-sdk 到最新版。

signals.topic: createSdkMcpServer 的 tools/list 因跨版本 zod schema 崩溃，导致服务器显示已连接但零工具
signals.summary: 当宿主使用的 zod 版本比 SDK 内置的新时，工具列表序列化过程调用外来 schema 的绑定 processor，抛出 TypeError 导致整个 tools/list 响应失败，服务器被报告为已连接但零工具，且无明显的错误归属，用户难以定位。
signals.review_reason: 用户在版本比内置更新的 zod 环境中使用 createSdkMcpServer 时，主流程 tools/list 直接失败且表现为静默的已连接零工具，无法获知是哪个工具导致，关键 MCP 功能不可用，属明确用户阻断。

source_issues.title: Cross-version zod schemas crash tools/list in createSdkMcpServer (connected but zero tools)
source_issues.evidence: z.record() 由 zod 4.6.5 构造，但包内置 4.4.3 的 context 没有 deferred 字段，walker 抛出 TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'push')；抛错发生在工具列表序列化时，整个 tools/list 响应失败，服务器被报告为 connected 且零工具，属静默的难归因失败。

signals.topic: query() 恢复会话后 total_cost_usd/modelUsage 变为会话累计，宿主无法按单次调用计量成本
signals.summary: 0.3.277 起 resume 会话后的 result 总费用变成整个会话累计值而非本次 query() 的值，而文档仍描述为开始清零。对按用户轮次计量成本的宿主（如按会话回复每条消息）造成重复计费，日计费严重虚高（实测 $669 对上约 $310 实际用量）。
signals.review_reason: 按用户轮次计量成本的宿主无法从 SDK 获得单次调用用量，导致成本计量虚高约一倍，产生明显成本损失与错误的计费数据，且文档与行为不一致，无宿主侧可靠修复手段。

source_issues.title: 0.3.277 made total_cost_usd / modelUsage session-cumulative on resume; no per-query() usage is left for hosts that meter individual turns
source_issues.evidence: 升级后每个后续轮次都被按其所在整个对话累计成本计费，某合并请求一天六个跟进轮次记 $8.95、$11.77、$12.63、$13.52、$18.30、$21.46，而按 per-message usage 实际约 $3；日总 $669 对约 $310 实际用量。result.usage 只覆盖最后一条 API 调用且输出 token 部分，per-message usage is 部分值，get_usage/get_session_cost 未暴露到 Query，宿主无法自行修复，只能持久化上次累计值再相减。

signals.topic: Action 在 PR 新增文件时因 SHA 计算时机过早而直接失败,导致带新增文件的 PR 无法进行 AI 审查
signals.summary: 在 PR 分支 checkout 前对新增文件执行 git hash-object 失败,导致任何含新增文件的 PR 无法进行 AI 审查,功能完全不可用。
aliases: PR review fails on files added in PR
signals.review_reason: 这是明确的主流程阻断问题:凡含新增文件的 PR 触发 @claude review 都以 status 128 崩溃,且无工作区可用的 workaround,用户只能改用本地 CLI,直接影响所有涉及新增文件的真实 PR 审查场景,严重限制 action 的日常可用性。单仓单 issue 且带完整复现与报错栈,故置信度高,但仅有 1 个实例,按规则不标记为 P0,降为 P1。

source_issues.title: Action fails on PRs with newly added files - git hash-object called before PR checkout
source_issues.evidence: 在 checkout PR 分支前于 fetchGitHubData()/prepareTagMode() 中对新增文件执行 git hash-object 失败,报错 'fatal: could not open ... No such file or directory'。任何包含新增文件的 PR 都会失败,无可用 workaround,用户只能改用本地 CLI,主流程阻断且复现明确。

signals.topic: 自动化模式在第 1 个 result 即终止,后台子代理的审查结果被静默丢弃,产生零评论的假成功
signals.summary: 自动化模式在第一条 result 消息即终止,后台子代理的审查结果被静默丢弃,产生零评论的假成功。
signals.review_reason: 用户在真实大规模 PR 上遭遇静默失败:job 认为成功、无报错,但拆给后台子代理的全部审查结果被丢弃,PR 拿到零评论,用户完全无感知,属于典型'看起来干净实际无效'的主流程缺陷,直接影响自动化 PR 审查的可靠性。仅 1 个实例且为较新 issue,置信度较高但按规则不标 P0。

source_issues.title: Automation mode stops at the first `result`; background subagents leave the review silently empty
source_issues.evidence: SDK runner 在第一条 result 消息处 break,而 run_in_background 子代理会带来 task_notification 与第二个 result。实测大 PR(100 文件,~12k diff)拆成 8 个后台代理后被 job 拆除,CLI 复现展示双 result 流,工作流绿但零审查评论且无任何报错。附 CLI 复现命令与真实运行日志。

signals.topic: 自托管 runner 上内联评论缓冲使用固定 /tmp 路径,导致跨仓库/跨 run 评论泄露以致清理审查反而失败
signals.summary: 自托管 runner 上内联评论缓冲使用固定 /tmp 路径,导致跨仓库/跨 run 评论泄露,使本应干净的审查失败。
signals.review_reason: 在自托管 runner 组织内有明确用户影响证据:跨仓库/跨 run 的评论状态泄漏,导致一次本应成功的干净审查步骤失败,且缓冲内容可能含他仓文件路径与代码片段构成隐私风险。虽仅 1 个实例且依赖自托管环境,但包含 4 条评论的确证与复现细节,按规则单 issue 不标 P0。

source_issues.title: Inline-comment buffer uses a fixed /tmp path that leaks comments across runs (and repos) on self-hosted runners
source_issues.evidence: BUFFER_PATH 固定为 /tmp/inline-comments-buffer.jsonl 且发布后不删除。自托管共享 runner 上 repo B 的干净审查误发 repo A 残留评论,仅靠 GitHub 422 路径校验才未泄出到错误 PR,且该步骤失败使本来干净的审查失败。OAuth 无密钥时还会'posting all unconfirmed comments'放大泄露范围。附被抄袭的 workaround(rm -f)。

signals.topic: claude_args 的 --system-prompt-file 无法覆盖默认 system prompt,自定义提示配置失效
signals.summary: claude_args 传入的 --system-prompt-file 无法覆盖默认 system prompt,自定义提示配置失效。
signals.review_reason: 用户试图通过配置自定义审查提示词但配置被静默忽略,关键的可定制能力不可用,导致审查行为不可控、体验下降。该 issue 已关闭且带有询问性质,影响证据较弱,故降为 P2,置信度下调。

source_issues.title: Unable to override system prompt
source_issues.evidence: 用户按文档在 claude_args 传入 --system-prompt-file,但日志中始终显示默认 system prompt 且看不到自己传入的内容,无法确认该参数是否受支持,已 close 但未提供有效覆盖方案。

signals.topic: Cowork 云会话无法关联/挂载/启动 VM，核心云会话功能在多个平台反复不可用
signals.summary: 用户在 macOS/Windows 上反复遇到 Cowork 云会话无法关联电脑、无法挂载文件夹或启动 VM，导致核心云会话功能不可用
signals.review_reason: 多个独立用户在 macOS/Windows 上反复遇到 Cowork 云会话无法关联电脑、无法挂载文件夹、无法启动 VM 等问题，核心云会话功能持续不可用（多 open+lingering），属于主流程阻断。

source_issues.title: macOS Cowork: Couldn't link this session to a computer since Desktop 2.9939.2 — Secure Enclave sign fails with OSStatus -25308
source_issues.evidence: Secure Enclave 签名失败 OSStatus -25308，每会话无法关联电脑，附着文件夹不可用，更新后仍复现。

source_issues.title: Cowork Windows 10 22H2 x64: sandbox-helper no Plan9 drive shares mounted — device_bash dead
source_issues.evidence: Windows 上 device_bash 因无 Plan9 驱动挂载完全失效，重启和更新都无法恢复。

source_issues.title: Cowork Windows — Shell/Bash cannot mount connected folders
source_issues.evidence: Windows 下 Shell/Bash 无法挂载连接文件夹（Plan9/virtiofs）。

source_issues.title: Cowork ARM64: VM boots but guest never connects, VM connection timeout
source_issues.evidence: VM 已引导但 guest 从不连接，60 秒连接超时。

source_issues.title: Desktop Commander MCP fails for Cowork/Code sessions, Version negotiation failed
source_issues.evidence: Cowork/Code 共享池会话 MCP 版本协商失败。

signals.topic: Claude 在编辑配置/语法敏感文件时过度自信,未实际验证就宣称修复,导致数据损坏、生产系统崩溃及用户时间与成本损失
signals.summary: 用户让 Claude 修复配置文件时,模型反复在不验证的情况下宣称文件已修复有效,实际通过 Get-Content/Set-Content 组合静默破坏含特殊字符(变音符号)的文件,导致整个 AppDaemon 仪表盘应用崩溃;模型对风险不事先提示、忽略自己此前发现的编码隐患,且在被质问前不坦承能力边界。用户付出数小时时间、反复重启生产系统并需手动创建备份。
signals.review_reason: 该 issue 提供了明确的用户影响证据:文件被静默破坏导致生产应用崩溃、用户耗费数小时并需反复重启系统、不得不手动创建备份。这属于真实使用中反复出现的主流程/工作流损坏问题,导致体验显著下降和明显时间成本损失,符合用户痛点的定义。虽为单条自报 issue(count=1、单仓),但用户影响证据充分(不仅针对安全关键词),故保留。

source_issues.title: Claude exhibits overconfidence when editing configuration files; repeatedly corrupts data it claims to have safely fixed
source_issues.evidence: 模型通过 Get-Content/Set-Content 组合静默破坏正确存储的变音符号导致 HADashboard 应用崩溃;宣称文件已修复有效却未先运行 YAML 校验器;忽略同一线程内自己发现的编码风险;仅在用户质问后才坦白局限。用户影响:'Hours of lost time, repeated restarts of a production system, and the user having to manually create backup copies of files (Home1.dash) just to stop the model from breaking things again.'

signals.topic: 官方插件市场目录/发布同步流程异常：安装页 404、已过审插件不出现、pin 陈旧导致安全修复无法交付
signals.summary: marketplace.json 中 310 个条目有 22 个在 claude.com 无对应插件页（含被文档作为安装入口的 mongodb-atlas），链接对用户失效；已过审的 skill-audit 等 5 天未同步进社区目录；remember 等 pin 因 bump 工作流被禁用而停在旧版本，导致包含注入防护绕过在内的 3 个安全修复用户无法获取且 plugin update 报已最新。
aliases: pin 陈旧安全修复缺失
signals.review_reason: 多个独立报告指向目录/发布流水线故障：用户点官方文档里的安装链接得到 404，已过审插件无法安装，且因 pin 陈旧无法获得含安全修复的新版本却被提示已是最新，属于明确的可用性、交付与安全成本损失，虽非主流程阻断但影响面广且反复出现。

source_issues.title: 22 of 310 marketplace.json entries have no claude.com/plugins page (mongodb-atlas missing since Aug 10)
source_issues.evidence: claude.com/plugins/<name> exists for 288 of the 310 entries ... returns HTTP 404 for 22 of them ... MongoDB's own documentation links it as the Claude install entry point, so those links are dead for users today.

source_issues.title: Plugin `skill-audit` passed review 2026-09-16 but is missing from claude-plugins-community marketplace.json
source_issues.evidence: five days and several nightly cycles after passing review, skill-audit is not in either catalog ... claude plugin validate passed before submission.

source_issues.title: remember: pin stale at 0.33.0 since the bump workflow was disabled; please advance to v0.36.0
source_issues.evidence: Three of them carry security fixes, including injection-guard bypasses and a gap in stripping credentials from untrusted config. Users who install only from this marketplace can't get them, and claude plugin update remember@claude-plugins-official tells them they are on the latest version.

source_issues.title: google-cloud-storage pin stale since the Sep 22 manual bumps; status of the new bump pipeline?
source_issues.evidence: The nightly Bump Plugin SHAs workflow has been disabled_manually since Sep 17 ... As of Sep 294 no bump PRs have been opened since then, so plugins whose sources changed after those batches are stuck on their old pins.

signals.topic: security-guidance 插件的 hook 无超时保护，进程挂起时阻塞编辑操作数分钟乃至流程长时间停滞
signals.summary: security-guidance 2.0.8 的两种 hook 缺少超时/探测边界：sg-python.sh 解释器探测无超时导致非返回的 python3 阻塞所有 hook；PostToolUse 没有显式 timeout，挂起的 hook 使每次 Edit/Write 卡住 600 秒，一次长 Workflow 中 34 次编辑调用各耗时 600.2-600.3s，流程多耗费约 5.7 小时并造成 26 次 prompt-cache 未命中。
aliases: hook 挂起无超时阻塞编辑
signals.review_reason: 用户在多代理长流程中实际遭遇每次编辑操作被挂起 hook 阻塞 600 秒，整体流程多花数小时并产生缓存未命中成本，主流程被明显阻断/拖慢，属于反复失败的性能与可用性痛点。
